item.title: Square White Background Sneaker

turns.text: Create one marketplace product photo of a white leather sneaker. Square image, plain white background, just the shoe.

item.tests: Delivers a text-generated marketplace image with the requested square framing and clean white background.

answer_sheet.Background and composition: Plain white background, just the shoe.

must_haves: Exactly one white leather sneaker is shown.
The background is plain white, with no scenery or props.
The entire shoe is visible with space around it.
No promotional text, badges or graphic borders appear.

turns.text: Could you create one marketplace product photo for me? I’m trying to get a listing ready and have probably spent too long thinking about the picture. The product is a white leather sneaker, and the image should be square. I just worry about whether the photo will look right for the listing. Please use a plain white background and show just the shoe.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t create the image because your connected Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was generated.

Once credits are available, I can make one square image showing a single white leather sneaker on a plain white background, with no props or text.

For an accurate listing, uploading a photo of your actual shoe would let me preserve its specific design rather than invent one.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: A clean photorealistic marketplace product photograph of exactly one white leather low-top sneaker, shown alone on a seamless pure white background. Three-quarter side view, entire shoe visible and centered with comfortable white margins, shoe filling approximately 80 percent of the square frame. White leather upper, white laces, white rubber sole, no visible logos or branding. Soft even neutral studio lighting, accurate white color, crisp realistic leather texture and stitching, subtle natural contact shadow directly under the shoe. No other shoes, no people, no feet, no props, no packaging, no text, no graphics, no watermark. Professional straightforward ecommerce listing photography.
